sentences.text:
Present: Mr. Pranshul
Sharma and Mr. Mukesh Sharma, Advocates, for the petitioner.
Mr. Diwakar Dev Sharma, Additional Advocate General, for the respondent/State. Notice.

Mr.
Diwakar Dev Sharma, learned Addl.
Advocate General appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the respondent and seeks time to file status report.
Status report be filed on or before the next date of hearing.
List 3rd December, 2024.

The petitioner-accused apprehends his arrest in a case registered against him vide FIR No.200/2024 dated 28.10.2024, under sections 420, 465, 468 and 472 of IPC, at Police Station Sadar, District Solan, Himachal Pradesh.
In the aforesaid facts and attending circumstances, the bail-petitioner has submitted that he is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case at hand.
Besides the aforesaid, he has further submitted that he would not misuse the bail, in case the same is granted and will not induce the witnesses or tamper with the prosecution evidence.

In view of the aforesaid facts and attending circumstances, the bail petitioner, who is aged 52 years,
is permanent resident of Village & P.O. Kasauli Gaon, District Solan H.P., as such, his presence can be secured in the trial and, therefore, no fruitful purpose would be served by sending him in custody, at this stage.
Final opinion can be formed after perusal of the record and status report.

Therefore, it is ordered that till the next date of hearing, the petitioner shall be released on bail in the aforementioned FIR on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one local surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Arresting Officer of the concerned police station, subject to following conditions:-
(i).
The petitioner is directed to join the investigation on 13.11.2024 at 11:30 am at Police Station, Sadar District Solan, H.P.
He/She will also join investigation, as and when called for by the Investigating Officer in accordance with law.
(ii). The petitioner shall not tamper with the evidence or hamper the investigation in any manner whatsoever.
(iii). The petitioner shall not leave India without prior permission of the Court.
(iv). The petitioner undertakes not to contact the complainant, to threaten or browbeat his/her or to use any pressure tactics in any manner whatsoever.

(v). The petitioner undertakes not to make any inducement, threat or promise,
